rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'Electric field intensity is the force on a charge.' ✅ It is the *force per unit positive test charge* at a point: E = F/q₀.  ·  ❌ 'Electric field lines represent the path of a particle.' ✅ They show the *direction* of the force on a positive charge; they don't necessarily represent the actual trajectory (except for stationary charges).

rows.label: Limitation
